title: A Lonely Traveler's Quest Across Perilous Lands

cuts.voiceover_text: Driven by desperate hope, a red-haired traveler stands before a grim gatekeeper. He demands to know why she entered his domain. She has survived brutal battles and ruined cities. She reveals she is searching for someone.

Now her journey takes her into a desolate desert. She marches across endless golden dunes on an earnest quest into the unknown. Isolation is nothing new to her. She admits she has been alone for as long as she can remember, but she refuses to give up.
